bio: The simple, cosy space with exposed beams and wooden furnishings exudes a warm feel. Balancing sweet, sour and salty notes with fiery heat, the chef turns fresh produce into modern Thai dishes that are packed with flavour. The small menu changes regularly but may include signatures such as smoky chargrilled pork jowl, or yellow crab curry with beautifully bold aromas. The friendly and dynamic service team is also a plus....
